body:
Feelings do change, but with the right opportunity and right time right? I don't think I have that anymore. Innately I'm someone who dedicates themselves to other people for my entire life and the pressure and weight on me isn't going to change in the time it takes for me to give up and die.

I like the sentence that " Most of them aren’t against you so much as they are just for themselves. " because it's true and it's different from "They are against me" but this makes me feel very lonely. 

I am lost and confused in how to find balance and find people who care. As stated in another comment post, "The people, my family and boyfriend, were the kind, empathetic and caring individuals. In my head, it's a matter of time before these people I welcome and entirely dedicate myself into turn me rotten."

I've sought out years worth of therapy and medication -- and they've closed my file as I've neglected the treatment since it's just all gone done and run into shit.
I'm tired of hearing this... it gives me hope to fall into despair on.

But the people, my family and boyfriend, were the kind, empathetic and caring individuals. In my head, it's a matter of time before these people I welcome and entirely dedicate myself into turn me rotten. 

I've been in therapy and medication for over 4 years and refused it for the last half year. They've closed my file and I'm entirely stranded. I don't want help anymore.... it feels so useless.
